criteria.dependency_check: root folder only, GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/; the file must match the group's language

exclusion_rule.how: repo name lowercased and split on - _ . into whole tokens; topics compared lowercased; description substring

query_template: language:<language> stars:<low>..<high> forks:>=50 pushed:>=2025-11-01 fork:false archived:false

search.split_rule: a slice with total_count > 1000 is split in half

sampling: pool per group sorted by repo id, shuffled with random.Random(f'{seed}-{group}'), walked in order; excluded repos skipped, the rest checked for a dependency file until the target is met

excluded_in_pool counts the whole pool; walk_by_group counts only the repos walked until the target was met.

Python repos must have requirements.txt in the root folder; pyproject.toml no longer counts (changed 2026-11-01). Reason: the Syft pilot (dataset/pilot_syft_results.csv) found no Python packages with Syft 1.17 in 7 of 8 repos that only had pyproject.toml, 2 of them with uv.lock.
